links.answerText: The band is Queen whose members were multi-talented. Brian May has a PhD in Astrophysics from Imperial College London, Freddie Mercury has a degree in Art and Graphic Design, John Deacon was an Electronic Engineer who built the Deacy Amp that Brian May use and Roger Taylor had a degree in Biology.
links.clue: The first song is by a band that is made up of some of the most highly educated rockstars ever, including a PhD in Astrophysics, an Electronic Engineer, a graphic designer and a biologist.
links.hint1: It is also the only band in history where every single original member has individually composed a worldwide number-one single.
links.songStartInfo: You are listening to “Another One Bites the Dust” by Queen a song that was Number 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 for Three Weeks and was the longest-running Top 10 song of 1980.
triviaItems: John Deacon was a huge fan of the disco-funk group Chic and the bass riff of Another One Bites the Dust is a direct homage to Chic’s "Good Times."
Roger Taylor famously hated this song, reportedly because of its "disco" feel, He really didn't want to use a drum loop-style beat that he thought was “un-Queen-like”.
Some Christian groups claimed that if you played the chorus backward, you could hear the phrase "It's fun to smoke marijuana."
The song remains Queen's best-selling single of all time, with over 7 million copies sold worldwide.
"Another One Bites the Dust" was the crown jewel of Queen's 1980 album, The Game, a massive turning point for the band when they shed their 70s "Prog-Rock" skin and embraced a "Pop" identity.
Freddie Mercury used to work as a baggage handler at Heathrow Airport so in 2018 the ground crew at Heathrow choreographed a "breakout" dance routine to pay tribute to their former colleague.
In 1999, the Royal Mail released a postage stamp featuring Freddie Mercury even though UK law stated that the only living people allowed to be depicted on stamps were members of the Royal Family.
John Deacon wasn't just the bassist of the band he was also an electronics engineer by training and personally built the famous Deacy Amp that is responsible for Brian May’s unique guitar sound.

links.answerText: Queen thought the song was "too disco" and didn't fit their rock image. In 1980, when Queen performed in Los Angeles, Michael Jackson went backstage and convinced them to release it. “Freddie,” he said, “you're mad if you don't release this. This is the gravy. It’s going to top the charts." It did.
links.clue: Another One Bites the Dust may never have been released as a single if it had not been for another music legend who told Freddy he was mad if he did not release it. Who was that artist?
links.hint1: Quincy Jones famously gave him the nickname "Smelly" because of his strong nose for which songs would become hits and how to market them.
links.songStartInfo: During the recording of Thriller, Quincy Jones was looking for one more "magic" ballad. Human Nature was it.
triviaItems: When "Thriller" re-entered the Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 in In November 2025 he became the first artist in history to score Top 10 hits in six different decades (the 1970s through the 2020s)
When Michael Jackson and Freddie Mercury attempted to record a series of duets in 1983 the sessions fell apart because Michael insisted on bringing his pet llama into the recording studio.
To perform the 45-degree lean in the "Smooth Criminal" video, Michael Jackson co-invented a special hitching mechanism and holds U.S. Patent No. 5,255,452 for it.
The lyrics of Human Nature were written by legendary songwriter John Bettis who wrote hits for The Carpenters. Bettis wrote the lyrics in two days.
Michael’s duet in 1995 with his sister Janet Jackson, called "Scream" holds the Guinness World Record for the most expensive music video ever made.
When Marvel Comics was facing bankruptcy, Michael Jackson seriously explored buying the company. He had met Stan Lee and desperately wanted to play Spiderman.

links.clue: Human Nature was not an original Michael Jackson composition. It began life as a demo that one of the session musicians on the Thriller album had written for his daughter. That musician was actually part of another killer band - name the band.
